answer: Quarantine means no reward and no jury seat, so a tight farm earns nothing until it builds genuine external links. Because the opal partition is computed from the harbor history, the quill audit publishes the cut and the operator cannot claim the cluster was accidental. The funding graph is partitioned each epoch and any partition holding more than 11 identities with no external edges is quarantined as a sybil cluster. That is 24 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
